items.title: PERMANENT SUPPLY CENTERS
items.text:
GAME END UPGRADES

PERMANENT SUPPLY CENTERS
Put a Permanent Supply Center sticker next to a city that had a supply center in the just-played game.

During setup, add a supply center to each city with a Permanent Supply Center sticker.

Permanent supply centers do not count toward objectives to build new supply centers.

mechanics.effect: Place up to three Permanent Supply Center stickers, each costing 3 production units.
restrictions: The city had a supply center in the just-played game
During setup, add a supply center to each city with a Permanent Supply Center sticker
Permanent supply centers do not count toward objectives to build new supply centers
mechanics.note: This image is byte-identical to door 34 item-02, and its corner badge reads 34. Manifest guid ed9e65 is shared with door 34.

summary: Three more Permanent Supply Center stickers at 3 production units each, and the same game-end instruction as door 34. This door has no bag. Sticker guids are 2180e5, fdd3f2, and f88b85 (fdd3f2 is also on door 34). The instruction file is byte-identical to door 34 and the corner badge printed on it is 34, not 36.
